COMMON QUESTIONS

Planning a horizontal line

What profile lengths are listed for the horizontal line?

Daimeng publishes a profile length range of 100–15,000 mm. Actual equipment configuration depends on the profile mix, loading method and process requirements.

Is the published capacity a guaranteed output?

No. The published design range is 100–5,000 tonnes per month. A project-specific capacity assessment must account for alloy, surface area, film thickness, finish mix, loading and operating hours.

Can optional finishes be included?

The published process description includes optional polishing, coloring and electrophoretic coating. Confirm the exact route and equipment scope in the project specification.
